# google_compute_snapshot_recycle_bin_policy

Represents the singleton resource Snapshot Recycle Bin Policy that
configures the retention duration for snapshots in the recycle bin.

~> **Warning:** This resource is in beta, and should be used with the terraform-provider-google-beta provider.
See [Provider Versions](../guides/provider_versions.html.markdown) for more details on beta resources.

To get more information about SnapshotRecycleBinPolicy, see:

* [API documentation](https://docs.cloud.google.com/compute/docs/reference/rest/beta/snapshotRecycleBinPolicy)
* How-to Guides
    * [Official Documentation](https://docs.cloud.google.com/compute/docs/disks/configure-recycle-bin)

## Example Usage - Snapshot Recycle Bin Policy Basic


```hcl
resource "google_compute_snapshot_recycle_bin_policy" "default" {
  provider = google-beta

  rules {
    name = "some-project/12345/6789"
    standard_snapshots {
      retention_duration_days = 2
    }
  }
}
```
## Example Usage - Snapshot Recycle Bin Policy Multiple


```hcl
resource "google_compute_snapshot_recycle_bin_policy" "multiple" {
  provider = google-beta

  rules {
    name = "some-project/54653/5476"
    standard_snapshots {
      retention_duration_days = 3
    }
  }

  rules {
    name = "some-project/12345/6789"
    standard_snapshots {
      retention_duration_days = 6
    }
  }
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:



* `rules` -
  (Optional)
  The rules for the snapshot recycle bin policy. The key name is either 'default'
  or namespaced name of the tag value which can be in the format:
  {organization_id}/{tag_key_short_name}/{tag_value_short_name} or
  {project_id}/{tag_key_short_name}/{tag_value_short_name} or
  {project_number}/{tag_key_short_name}/{tag_value_short_name}. The default rule is
  applied if snapshots do not have any of these tags. The value is the rule for the key.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_rules).

* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
    If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

* `deletion_policy` - (Optional) Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the resource. Defaults to DELETE.
	When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the resource,
	the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
	When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
	management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
	When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.


<a name="nested_rules"></a>The `rules` block supports:

* `name` - (Required) The identifier for this object. Format specified above.

* `standard_snapshots` -
  (Optional)
  The rule config for standard snapshots.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_rules_standard_snapshots).


<a name="nested_rules_standard_snapshots"></a>The `standard_snapshots` block supports:

* `retention_duration_days` -
  (Optional)
  The retention duration for snapshots in the recycle bin after which the
  snapshots are automatically deleted from recycle bin.

## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `projects/{{project}}/global/snapshotRecycleBinPolicy`

* `system_rules` -
  The system rules for snapshot recycle bin policy. Defines the default rule that applies if no customer-defined
  rule matches.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_system_rules).


<a name="nested_system_rules"></a>The `system_rules` block contains:

* `name` - (Required) The identifier for this object. Format specified above.

* `standard_snapshots` -
  (Output)
  The rule config for standard snapshots.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_system_rules_standard_snapshots).


<a name="nested_system_rules_standard_snapshots"></a>The `standard_snapshots` block contains:

* `retention_duration_days` -
  (Output)
  The retention duration for snapshots in the recycle bin after which the
  snapshots are automatically deleted from recycle bin.

## Timeouts

This resource provides the following

## Import


SnapshotRecycleBinPolicy can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `projects/{{project}}/global/snapshotRecycleBinPolicy`
* `{{project}}`

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, use an [`identity` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/block/import#identity) to import SnapshotRecycleBinPolicy using identity values. For example:

```tf
import {
  identity = {
    project = "<-optional value->"
  }
  to = google_compute_snapshot_recycle_bin_policy.default
}
```

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import SnapshotRecycleBinPolicy using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "projects/{{project}}/global/snapshotRecycleBinPolicy"
  to = google_compute_snapshot_recycle_bin_policy.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), SnapshotRecycleBinPolicy can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_compute_snapshot_recycle_bin_policy.default projects/{{project}}/global/snapshotRecycleBinPolicy
$ terraform import google_compute_snapshot_recycle_bin_policy.default {{project}}
```
